Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

Drawing Nos : 001-02 Rev E; 002-02 Rev E;  003-02 Rev D; 004-02 Rev F; 005-02 Rev F; 020-02 Rev F; 021a-02 Rev G; 021b-02 Rev H; 022-02 Rev G; 023a-02 Rev H; 023b-02 Rev H;  030-02 Rev G;  031-02 Rev G;  032-02 Rev G; 033-02 Rev F; 034-02 Rev E all Submitted 02/11/2026

3 Ravenscourt Place, Hammersmith, London Flood Risk Assessment MARCH 2026 REF: 3649/RE/01-25/01 REVISION E



To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

Single-storey ground-floor rear and side extension: London stock brick to match existing.
 
Rear and side elevations of the existing two-storey rear extension: Breathable fibreboard insulation finished in breathable lime render.

Roof: Tiled roofing and dark grey single-ply membrane roofing; glazed aluminium-framed roof to side return extension finished in RAL 9017 (Traffic Black); lead trims and flashings.

Second-floor mansard rear extension: tiled roofing to match the main roof of the parent building. 

Ground and first-floor windows to the existing two-storey rear extension: Heritage-standard triple-glazed hardwood timber windows with Accoya beads; aluminium-framed glazed system finished in RAL 9017 (Traffic Black).

Ground-floor doors to the existing two-storey rear extension and the rear elevation of the main building: Heritage-standard triple-glazed hardwood timber doors with Accoya beads; aluminium-framed glazed system to the rear ground floor and outrigger finished in RAL 9017 (Traffic Black).

Boundary Treatments: Existing fence and trellis retained; extension finished in London stock brick slips to match adjacent existing walls.

Hard Surfacing: SuDS-compliant permeable paving to the rear garden and planted beds; existing concrete side returns and front parking retained.

Rainwater Goods and Pipework: Black textured aluminium gutters and rainwater goods; black plastic foul waste pipework.

- Replacement windows: Double or triple glazed timber windows and door, with details including the colours, opening mechanism, glazing configuration, and run through sash horns to match the existing/original windows.

- Door � timber

Condition : 4 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment [3 Ravenscourt Place, Hammersmith, London Flood Risk Assessment NOVEMBER 2026 REF: 3649/RE/01-25/01 REVISION E]. No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter.

To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - Prior to commencement of the development hereby approved, a Construction Logistics Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Council. The Construction Logistics Plan should seek to minimise the impact of construction traffic on nearby roads and restrict construction trips to off peak hours only. Details shall include, but not be limited to, the numbers, size and routes of construction vehicles, loading and unloading of construction materials and whether the suspension of any on-street car parking bays would be necessary. Approved details shall be implemented throughout the project period.
 
To ensure that construction works do not adversely impact on the operation of the public highway, in accordance with Policies T1 and T7 of the Local Plan (2018). 
Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until the following documents, in consultation with London Underground, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which:

a.	Provide detailed design and Risk Assessment Method Statement on the use of heavy vehicle, tall plant, scaffolding and lifting equipment.

To ensure that the development does not impact on existing London Underground transport infrastructure, in accordance with the London Plan 2021 Policy T3 and 'Land for Industry and Transport' Supplementary Planning Guidance 2012.
Condition : 7 - The balustrade of the Juliet balcony at first floor level [022-02 Rev G] hereby permitted shall be fixed flush with the rear elevation of the building at the same time as the associated doors are installed. The doors to the Juliet balconies shall open inwards only. The doors and balustrades shall be permanently retained in this form for the lifetime of the development.  

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC8 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018). 
Condition : 8 - The flank elevation semi-circular fanlights at ground floor level [031-02 Rev G] shall be fitted with obscure glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3, and shall be fixed shut.  The windows shall thereafter be permanently retained in this form. 

To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018). 
Condition : 9 - The roof of the ground-floor extension and the roof of the second-floor rear extension hereby approved, and the remainder of the roof of the existing back addition, shall not be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the remainder of the roof of the back addition and the extensions hereby approved. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roofs and no alterations shall be carried out to the property, including the extension hereby approved, to form an access onto the roofs.  

Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Alterations to the main roof of the parent building, including an increase in height of 0.75m and the Replacement of 2 no. existing windows with new triple-glazed timber-framed windows at second-floor level on the front elevation; Replacement of the main roof covering with a new roof covering; Erection of a rear extension at second-floor level above the existing back addition; Erection of a single-storey extension to the side of the main building and to the side of the ground-floor rear back addition; Installation of 1 no. new window at first-floor level and 2 no. new windows at ground-floor level on the side (eastern) elevation; Replacement of existing windows and doors with new windows and doors in matching materials and details; Replacement of 1 no. existing ground-floor rear elevation door with 1 no. new timber door with a semi-circular fanlight; Replacement of 1 no. existing ground-floor window and door on the flank elevation of the rear extension with 3 no. new timber doors with semi-circular fanlights; Replacement of 1 no. existing ground-floor window on the rear elevation of the rear extension with 1 no. new timber door; Replacement of 1 no. existing first-floor window on the rear elevation of the rear extension with 1 no. new timber door and Juliette balcony; Installation of solar panels on the main roof and above the second-floor rear extension; Additional external insulation in breathable materials to the flank and rear walls; and Associated landscaping in the rear garden, comprising permeable paving to replace the existing impermeable concrete/paved surface.
